messages.subject: A Book Written From the Heart
messages.subject_clean: A Book Written From the Heart
messages.body_plain:
A Personal Journey, a Humble Request, and a Book from My Heart

Dear Friend,

Life has not been an easy road for me. Growing up with five siblings, I found myself taking on the role of the breadwinner far earlier than most. The weight of responsibility was heavy, but it also taught me re-silience, hope, and the importance of helping one another through life’s storms.

In the middle of these struggles, I decided to write a book — not just to tell my story, but to inspire others facing their own challenges. This book is filled with lessons, encouragement, and a message I truly believe can change lives.

Unfortunately, I don’t yet have the funds to publish it traditionally. So, I’ve made it available as a PDF, so anyone can read it instantly. Today, I’m reaching out with a humble request: if you can, please consider purchasing my book for just $10.

Your support will not only help me continue providing for my family, but also give this message a chance to reach and uplift others. I believe every helping hand will be rewarded abundantly, and I am deeply grateful to anyone moved to Purchase in good terms of help.

Get Your Copy Here: penwr...@signinid.com

>From my heart to yours — thank you for reading, for caring, and for making a difference.

With gratitude and blessings,

PEN WRITERS
penwr...@signinid.com
